operationSets.name: TicketTriage
operationSets.comment:
A ticket's triage for any signed-in caller (D73, D103's step 4): a
deriver pulls the stale fields at ticket/derived/stale-derivations and
settles its answers at ticket/derived/settle-derivations, routes of the
table as a whole; applyDerived and rederive are routes of the row under
derived, and a reviewer's accept and reject routes of the row under
provenance, beside the status Workflow's transition.

operations.name: derivedStaleDerivations
operations.comment: Lists the derived fields a deriver should compute, oldest first: each one's instance id, field, inputs by field name, instruction, model label, the field's JSON Schema as output, the hash to present and the attempt number. Leaves out a field outside its states, one overridden, one whose inputs are all absent and one out of attempts. Needs the config's permission.

docs.title: Ticket derived: stale derivations
docs.description: Lists the derived fields a deriver should compute, oldest first: each one's instance id, field, inputs by field name, instruction, model label, the field's JSON Schema as output, the hash to present and the attempt number. Leaves out a field outside its states, one overridden, one whose inputs are all absent and one out of attempts. Needs the config's permission.

operations.name: derivedSettleDerivations
operations.comment: Settles what a deriver computed from staleDerivations: each item a value, or a failure, with the hash it pulled. Values are written instance by instance through applyDerived, each instance in one event; an item whose hash moved, whose instance is gone, whose field was overridden or left its states, whose value the type refuses, or that another behavior vetoes is skipped, and the others still settle. A failure, an invalid value or a veto counts an attempt and appends no event. An item given twice, or with both a value and a failure, refuses the whole call. Needs the config's permission.

docs.title: Ticket derived: settle derivations
docs.description: Settles what a deriver computed from staleDerivations: each item a value, or a failure, with the hash it pulled. Values are written instance by instance through applyDerived, each instance in one event; an item whose hash moved, whose instance is gone, whose field was overridden or left its states, whose value the type refuses, or that another behavior vetoes is skipped, and the others still settle. A failure, an invalid value or a veto counts an attempt and appends no event. An item given twice, or with both a value and a failure, refuses the whole call. Needs the config's permission.

operations.name: derivedFailedDerivations
operations.comment: Lists the derived fields out of attempts, oldest first, with each one's last failure. Needs the config's permission.

docs.title: Ticket derived: failed derivations
docs.description: Lists the derived fields out of attempts, oldest first, with each one's last failure. Needs the config's permission.

operations.name: derivedApplyDerived
operations.comment: Writes derived values on the instance, each with the hash it was computed under: through update(), so the type's validation and every guard judge them, attributed to Derived with each value's confidence. Refused for a field the config does not derive, one a write overrode, one outside its states and one whose hash moved. Needs the config's permission; settleDerivations calls it.

docs.title: Ticket derived: apply derived
docs.description: Writes derived values on the instance, each with the hash it was computed under: through update(), so the type's validation and every guard judge them, attributed to Derived with each value's confidence. Refused for a field the config does not derive, one a write overrode, one outside its states and one whose hash moved. Needs the config's permission; settleDerivations calls it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

operations.name: derivedRederive
operations.comment: Makes derived fields stale again, every one when fields is absent: clears an override, the failed attempts, and the last value's hash, so the deriver computes them anew. The values stay until new ones settle.

docs.title: Ticket derived: rederive
docs.description: Makes derived fields stale again, every one when fields is absent: clears an override, the failed attempts, and the last value's hash, so the deriver computes them anew. The values stay until new ones settle.
